objective: Re-assess repair commit 74d9379 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-tool-settings against the two security findings it repairs.
scope: Finding 1: a symlinked .pi folder or target at project/local scope redirected the write and --undo. Finding 2: at project/local scope a project write could override a value the global file set (computer-use confirmations, Moonshot tools).
Check races (a symlink created between the check and the write), a symlinked parent above .pi, hard links, and whether --undo can still edit through a link.
constraints: Read-only; no edits and no version-control writes.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path.

criteria.text: No untrusted input chooses the written path or makes setup or undo change a value the user set
No written value overrides a risky setting the user chose in the global file
